project_context.purpose: EVD-0005 Monster基礎StatusとEVD-0004 Monster装備係数から算出したMonster全7職Lv1～50戦闘値を、Human指定丸め規則適用後の固定Baseline Evidenceとして保存する。
project_context.summary: 7職×Lv1～50=350行、1Lv=1行。連続装備相当式でHP/MP/Attack/Accuracy/Magic/Evasionを算出し、Critical/Shield Blockも含める。小数値は四捨五入で整数化し、非0が0になる場合は1、元0は0を維持する。

current_focus.goal: Monster戦闘値を1Lv単位で後工程から再参照可能な数値Authorityとして登録する。

source_baseline.source_role: Human-provided Fresh Current after TASK-BAL-074-INFRA-006 Studio Formal Shield offensive correction

authority_basis.critical_rate: Primary Weapon weapon_critical_rate = 5% baseline; Battle base_critical_rate_percent = weapon_critical_rate_percent * (1 + Monster LUK / 100). M_s/P_s is not applied to Critical. No additional Critical Contribution in EVD-0006.
authority_basis.block_rate: Shield only: 20% + 2 percentage points * (fractional Shield Virtual iLv - 1); M_s/P_s is not applied.

rounding_rule.scope: all displayed/final combat numeric fields with fractional values, including Block rate

authority_basis.row_granularity_rule: Each Level is stored independently even when adjacent Levels have equal values.
authority_basis.human_review: All formulas and all 7-job Lv1-50 rounded results were presented before Evidence creation; Human then instructed output as EVD-0006.
